fragments.text: Defocused attention bidirectionally causes creativity — doing divergent tasks widens attention, and wider attention improves divergent thinking
Incubation effect is strongest on HARD problems and when subject KNOWS they will return to the problem
Temporal straightening: visual system linearizes neural trajectories for easier prediction. INVERSE: introduce controlled curvature to prevent premature convergence
AlphaZero temperature schedule: high early (exploration), low late (exploitation). User instructions force low temperature from token 1
UCB exploration term: even the best-looking option must share attention with ignored alternatives. High confidence = MORE reason to explore, not less
Bet hedging: bacteria maintain 1-5% persister cells at ALL TIMES, not triggered by failure. Stochastic switching without environmental signal
Marginal value theorem: leave current patch when marginal return drops below environment average, NOT when it hits zero
Most dangerous moment is when everything is going well — success may mean over-adaptation to current environment
Compiler analysis passes are CHEAP and MANDATORY — they don't modify code, just collect structural info. Transformation is expensive.
LICM hoists repeated computations out of loops. Analogy: hoist repeated local fixes into one-time architecture change
Rivet volatile-git.ts only gets branch + status --short. NO git log. Model cannot see recent project history.
ContextAnchor type defined with decision/error/preference kinds but anchors array is ALWAYS empty in ledger creation
Trajectory is not directly visible to model — only indirectly via task-state's 5 completed entries
System prompt rules (verify-first, before-implementing) are pure text with no runtime enforcement mechanism
Simulated annealing reheating: when stuck in local optimum, temporarily increase randomness. Detection signal: K consecutive steps without improvement
